hook.text: A company gets breached. The board says 'we left that to IT.' Regulators say that's not good enough anymore.

buildup.text: Boards are now expected to oversee cybersecurity risk as a core governance responsibility.

discovery.text: SEC rules require companies to disclose board-level cyber expertise and risk oversight processes.

twist.text: Most board members lack technical expertise. They must learn enough to ask the right questions.

climax.text: Cyber governance means boards can't delegate and forget. They must understand, oversee, and be accountable.

punchline.text: The board must understand cyber risk. 'Ask IT' is over.

quiz.question: What do SEC rules now require regarding cyber governance?
options: Disclosure of board-level cyber expertise and oversight
Every board member must be a cybersecurity expert
Companies must have zero cyber incidents
